title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-02-28
lineage: 16-Track Master Reel> DAT> CD> EAC> SHN, with various patches (see info file)

ai_review.summary: A monster soundboard recording of the Fillmore West 2/28/69 run – studio‑quality audio captures an insanely high‑energy set with a smoking Eleven, epic Dark Star/Other One chain and a killer Alligator→Caution jam.
ai_review.review: The show is hailed as one of the Dead’s greatest, with seamless segues (Cryptical > Too > Cryptical, The Other One > Dark Star > St. Stephen > Eleven) and blistering performances that keep the energy at a fever‑pitch throughout.  The soundboard source is virtually studio‑like, though a few listeners note reversed stereo channels and minor patch‑lag issues on the master reel.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews (majority 5‑star) praise both musical performance and audio fidelity; only a handful of low‑star comments mention access problems or minor technical quirks, so the combined weighted rating is very high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, studio‑like clarity; some users report reversed left/right channels on the master reel and slight patch lag/pitch issues in the Alligator jam, but overall mix is balanced and very listenable.

standout_songs: Dark Star > St. Stephen > The Eleven
The Other One > Dark Star > St. Stephen
show_quality.setlist_flow: Exceptional flow with multiple flawless transitions—Cryptical > Too > Cryptical, The Other One into Dark Star, and an uninterrupted Alligator‑Caution sequence that drives the second set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for a perfect guitar tone on Lovelight and soaring leads during The Eleven; described as “smoking” and “killing it.”
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for “bombing” bass lines, especially on The Eleven where his lock‑step interplay with Jerry is highlighted.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned for solid rhythm work and vocal contributions, though no specific standout comment beyond general praise of the band’s cohesion.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann and Mickey Hart are referenced in a technical note about channel reversal; overall drum work described as powerful, especially during the Alligator jam.
